Full Script Text: Stage Settings The ‘stage’ represents Clare’s cell in her monastery at San Damiano. It is split like a triangle into 3 sections around the font in the centre. For the sake of a unified language, let's call these the ‘three stations of her cell’. The first station ( facing the audience directly on all sides at the top of the font) is a small clothes rack and a simple chair. The second station ( down stage right) is a straw mat where she sleeps. The Third Station ( down stage left) is a little table with a chair) Clare plays and performs intermittently between the three stations. Francis, a primary character in the play, walks in between these stations as if a memory in her mind. He sits on the stage right of the sanctuary. But for the beginning of the show, father is seated in the pews. A two person choir sits stage left of the altar. Most of the action takes place below the sanctuary around the three stations of the cell.
